science_sections.why: 486958 Arrokoth (visited by New Horizons in 2019) is the most distant solar-system object ever explored — a primordial Kuiper-belt contact binary that has likely never been warmed by the Sun.
Arrokoth orbits at 44.6 AU — classical Kuiper Belt, beyond Pluto, in a region where bodies have been mostly undisturbed since the early solar system.
